> Since we have keys for all indices (which is the way to go IMO), how are we going to handle URL routing?
>
> My guess would be that when we detect there's a single index used, we keep the same structure as right now. Once there are multiple indices, we change the structure of the URL. This won't bring breaking changes, which is delicate when it comes to routing because we break all existing URLs.

Yes forgot to mention it inside the description (I've added it), but the idea is to be able to detect somewhere (state mapping? before the call to state mapping? This can be decided when we adapt the URLSync) that we are inside a single/multi index context. For a single index, we should keep the same shape of URL that we have today. For a multi-index then we use the default serializer. Note that if users wrote their state mapping they might have to update themselves to match the new structure (depends on the solution we choose).
